messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered: GPU_NVML_MEMORY_HIGH on pool=west2-gpu-pool node=gpu-34 threshold=0.95. Alert PD-48291. Logs show intermittent CUDA_ALLOC_ERROR and repeated nvml OOM warnings.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-48291 — page fired, routing to current oncall (alex).

alex: @incident-bot ack — I'm oncall and taking this. Can someone paste the latest nvml/nvidia-smi snapshot and any container logs? Any customer impact reports?

jess: Seeing elevated retries and a small bump in 5xxs for embedding requests. Looks correlated with requests hitting gpu-34. No broad customer outage yet but one tenant has repeated long-running decodes.

maria: @alex Suggest cordon + drain gpu-34, redirect traffic to west2-burst and fallback model variant `redwood-lg-small` (lower memory footprint) while we rebalance.

alex: Doing cordon now:
```
$ kubectl cordon gpu-34
node/gpu-34 cordoned
```

incident-bot: Autoscaler update: Node replacement started, expected new node within ~120s. Rebalancing may cause transient kvcache misses.

alex: Starting drain:
```
$ kubectl drain gpu-34 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
evicted 12 pods, 3 pods pending termination
```

jess: Tracing confirms single tenant running multiple heavy decodes. I've applied a temporary rate-limit rule for that tenant to reduce concurrent decodes, and opened a customer ticket.

alex: Marking incident acknowledged and mitigation in progress. Redirected routing to pool west2-burst and scaled up fallback pool. Monitoring GPU mem and latency now.

pagerduty-bot: PD status: acknowledged by alex. Escalation suppressed.

maria: Post-mitigation action items: investigate kvcache eviction policy and model-host container memory usage. Potential memory leak in latest model-image. Recommend limiting max-concurrent-decodes and raising kv-cache TTL.

alex: Filing follow-up ticket ENG-1234 with owner=jess and owner=maria for RCA and remediation. If repeat occurs, we'll open a postmortem.

jess: :white_check_mark: All pods rescheduled, GPU mem on affected nodes stable ~45%. kvcache miss rate returning to baseline.

alex: Monitoring for 10 more minutes, will close PD if stable.

pagerduty-bot: PD: Incident resolved by alex.

alex: Closing thread — no further customer impact observed. Will coordinate on the ENG-1234 runbook tomorrow.
